lines:
Responsibilities: Streams only export-policy-permitted evidence artifacts into content-addressed storage and serves verified, bounded reads. Project workspace files remain in place and are represented by ProjectFileRefV1 rather than copied by default.
Owned files/records: artifacts/sha256/<prefix>/<digest> contains exact inert bytes; an immutable ArtifactDescriptorV1 records sha256 digest, byte length, portable media type, semantic kind, producing EventId, optional safe display name, policy version/hash, and no execute bit or launch command. ArtifactId is the content digest; duplicate content is idempotent. Staging files are never canonical.
Ports/DTOs: PreparePermittedArtifact(ArtifactCandidateV1), FinalizeArtifact, VerifyArtifact, ReadArtifactRange, and EnumerateArtifactDescriptors return PreparedArtifactV1/ArtifactRefV1 or stable rejection codes. The commit coordinator alone can make a prepared artifact reachable from a committed segment; projection consumers receive descriptors and explicitly bounded content only.
Admission and security: a versioned allowlist admits size-bounded inert text/JSON, safe raster media, and explicitly classified evidence such as plain-text patches. It rejects executable binaries/scripts, plugin/adapter bundles, active-content formats, executable metadata, credentials, unsafe debug captures, and ambiguous types. Stored bytes are never made executable, launched, installed, auto-applied, or supplied to a plugin. Content sniffing complements, never replaces, typed provenance and export policy.
Atomicity/degradation/NFRs: stream to a same-directory temp while hashing and enforcing quotas, fsync, then create-new rename and directory fsync. Hash mismatch, path collision, scan failure, or unsupported media fails closed. Reads recheck descriptor length/hash when integrity status is stale. Use bounded memory, range reads, cancellation, deduplicated quotas, and cross-platform permission tests.
Non-responsibilities: no arbitrary project-file backup, semantic event commit, branch reachability decision, credential store, artifact execution/materialization, Git operation, or deletion of reachable artifacts.

data.name: Permitted Content-Addressed Artifact Store
data.technology: Rust streaming SHA-256 CAS with policy-gated inert artifact descriptors
